| Build a dedicated cloud data lake | Cloudwick, ClearScale |
| Enterprise-wide transformation | NTT DATA, Accenture |

These are use-case-based recommendations, not verified rankings of delivery quality. [dataconsultingfirms.com](https://dataconsultingfirms.com/data-engineering-consulting?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[findalternatives.net](https://findalternatives.net/directory/data-lake-consulting-companies?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[decisionminds.com](https://decisionminds.com/articles/best-data-engineering-consulting-firms-us-2026-guide?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What to evaluate before signing

Ask each consulting firm to demonstrate\:

- **Platform expertise\:** Production experience with your target stack, such as AWS S3, Azure Data Lake Storage, Google Cloud Storage, Databricks, or Snowflake.
- **Architecture\:** Ability to assess a traditional data lake versus a lakehouse architecture, including open table formats such as Apache Iceberg and Delta Lake.
- **Governance and security\:** Data cataloging, lineage, access controls, encryption, compliance, and data quality.
- **Migration experience\:** Reference projects with comparable data volumes, source systems, and performance requirements.
- **Total cost of ownership\:** Storage, compute, data transfer, ongoing support, and platform optimization.
- **Delivery evidence\:** Customer references, named technical leads, and measurable results from completed projects.

## What to evaluate before signing

Ask each consulting firm to demonstrate\:

- **Platform expertise\:** Production experience with your target stack, such as AWS S3, Azure Data Lake Storage, Google Cloud Storage, Databricks, or Snowflake.
- **Architecture\:** Ability to assess a traditional data lake versus a lakehouse architecture, including open table formats such as Apache Iceberg and Delta Lake.
- **Governance and security\:** Data cataloging, lineage, access controls, encryption, compliance, and data quality.
- **Migration experience\:** Reference projects with comparable data volumes, source systems, and performance requirements.
- **Total cost of ownership\:** Storage, compute, data transfer, ongoing support, and platform optimization.
- **Delivery evidence\:** Customer references, named technical leads, and measurable results from completed projects.
